name: NBIS AI Fundamental Valuation
rationale: Nebius Group N.V. (NBIS) is emerging as the premier European sovereign AI neocloud, building hyperscale GPU clusters powered by an official NVIDIA partnership. TTM revenue surged +454% YoY to $529.8M as capacity came online. At $206.32, 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $262.62 (+27.3% upside at 10% discount rate). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in a 79.1% 5-year CAGR, matching rapid datacenter megawatt expansion plans. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 9.0 shares). Target accumulation on dips below $196.97, trim Tier 1 at $262.62.

bear.rationale: Neocloud GPU rental commoditization accelerates as Tier-2 cloud capacity expands and hyperscalers restrict external workloads. Revenue reaches $4.7B by Year 5 (55% CAGR from $530M baseline). High power/datacenters lease costs and price competition limit net margin to 18%. Exit multiple contracts to 22x commodity infrastructure multiple.
risks: GPU rental price deflation across neocloud competitors (CoreWeave, Lambda Labs)
High ongoing capex diluting share count (3% annual dilution)

base.rationale: NVIDIA strategic alliance and full-stack software integration (Slurm orchestration, proprietary AI cloud stack, developer tools) secure high-margin enterprise AI training contracts. Revenue expands at 78% 5-year CAGR to $9.4B. Operating leverage drives 25% net margin. Premium 30x multiple reflects mission-critical European and sovereign AI compute leadership.
risks: Execution delays in scaling European multi-hundred megawatt datacenter campuses
Power interconnection queues delaying cluster online dates

bull.rationale: Nebius becomes the undisputed sovereign AI cloud powerhouse for Europe and frontier AI labs. Hyper-scale GPU clusters expand revenue at 98% CAGR to $15.3B. Proprietary full-stack cloud software layer commands 32% net margin. Premium multiple commands 38x top-tier AI compute multiple.
risks: Export controls or geopolitical regulatory friction across European operations
Next-generation ASIC architectures reducing demand for general-purpose GPU clusters
